# Test fixtures

All files are generated by `npm run fixtures` (`scripts/make-fixtures.mjs`, requires `qpdf`) and contain only fictional placeholder text. No real personal data.

| File | What it is | Used to verify |
|---|---|---|
| `valid.pdf` | One-page Letter PDF made with pdf-lib (Helvetica, fictional "Example Co." text) | Successful open |
| `truncated.pdf` | First 120 bytes of `valid.pdf` (has `%PDF-` header, no body/xref) | "damaged" error |
| `image-renamed.pdf` | An 8×8 PNG saved with a `.pdf` name | "not a PDF" error (content sniffing) |
| `encrypted-user-aes256.pdf` | `valid.pdf` encrypted by qpdf, AES-256, user password `user-pass` | Encrypted: user password |
| `encrypted-user-rc4.pdf` | `valid.pdf` encrypted by qpdf, RC4 128-bit, user password `user-pass` | Encrypted: legacy RC4 |
| `encrypted-owner-only.pdf` | `valid.pdf` encrypted by qpdf, AES-256, empty user password, owner password `owner-pass` | Encrypted: owner-password only (opens without a password) |

Larger generated fixtures (e.g. the 10-page, 5 MB performance PDF) are written to `tests/fixtures/generated/` at test time and are not committed.
